notes.title: Shan Gui: Definitive Edition Released & Shan Gui II -50%
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Fan or not, maybe you've already heard that "[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/307050/discussions/0/357287304431021101/]News[/url]" on Shan Gui which we involved in years ago, we're very sorry for the inconvenient on this these years.

To offer the lastest, and also the best experience, on Shan Gui, we once included it in Bai Qu. Since Shan Gui II Chapter 2 has been released early 2020, in order to make it more convenient for you to experience this work, we now annoucend Shan Gui: Definitive Edition - the latest DLC for Shan Gui II. And as a thank you gift to our fans who have been supporting us, it's free!

Shan Gui: Definitive Edition contains all content we've ever released so far, and with the following huge improvements:
● Both 2012 and 2014 version graphic included, one game, two piece of memories, you could easily switch it in the options menu.
● The resolution has been increased to 2560x1440 (both in 2012 and 2014 version).
● The 2014 version of the ED, which no longer uses the video format, is changed to the same engine-only rendering mode as the Android version, which will bring a great improvement in clarity and playback performance.
● During these years, we have done lots of optimizing work on the vocal resource of the game, and remade some parts. In the Definitive version, the quality of He Jia and Han Hui's voices have been greatly improved, and the voice of Li Qiucheng and the Teahouse Manager have been re-recorded.
● With the latest Ren'Py Engine, we've cleared some bugs that have been existing for years. Now Shan Gui: Definitive Edition is excellent in details such as font rendering and gamepad support.
● Lots of minor issues fixed. (eg. hyperlink failure.)
● Multiple new localization ​​added.
● Minor adjustments on UI.
● Continuously tech supporting and updating to improve the game experience.

To offer you a consistent and best experience, we'll remove the files of Shan Gui and it's OST that included in Bai Qu after 90 days. The Shan Gui OST will be included into Shan Gui II OST. And as a celebration on the release of Definitive Edition. We will run a weeklong 50% off discount at 10:00 am May 25th (PDT). Enjoy it :)

notes.title: Chapter Two Pulished (with OST and Artbook)
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/955180/
Dear friends, thanks for your waiting. Today (Feb. 8th) we formally published the second chapter of [i]Shan Gui II[/i] with its ost and artbook. Remember you must [b]download it manually[/b], and [b]open the game outside of 'download' page[/b]. Wish you could enjoy it.
P.S.1: We are working on English version now.
P.S.2: All team members are safe from coronavirus's threat. Don't worry.

Notice: You must start game from the green button in Library, not from download page nor DLC gain storepage.

预售地址：https://item.taobao.com/item.htm?id=610301125503
此外，关注制作组官方微博@洋红工房 并转发相关微博，将有机会获得《百曲》的实体版一份或《山桂贰》究极豪华实体版一份。抽奖结果将于2020年除夕当晚公布。
